title: Auxiliary valuation of a false prefix
statement: Let $\alpha$ be an assignment on $V$, let $L$ be a list of literals over $V$, and let $j$ satisfy $j+2\le |L|$. The auxiliary valuation associated with $\alpha$, $L$, and $j$ holds if and only if every one of the first $j+2$ literals of $L$ is false under $\alpha$.
replaced:
Fix an assignment $\alpha$ and a list of literals $\mathit{lits}$, and let $j$ be an
index with $j + 2 \le |\mathit{lits}|$. Then the auxiliary variable valuation associated
with $\alpha$, $\mathit{lits}$, and $j$ holds if and only if every one of the first $j +
2$ literals of $\mathit{lits}$ evaluates to false under $\alpha$.
